title: Ringed-slice extension reflects exactness
statement: Let C be a category with object universe u and morphism universe v, J a Grothendieck topology, O a sheaf of commutative rings with values in universe max u v, and U an object. Write R for its underlying ring sheaf, and L for the direct-sum extension from R.over U-module sheaves followed by module sheafification, all module values in universe max u v, as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-preserves-exact]. For every short complex S of R.over U-module sheaves, imageSubobject (L.map S.f) = kernelSubobject (L.map S.g) implies S.Exact.

proof.text: For a slice module G, a base object V and an arrow phi : V -> U, prove that the composite of the phi-summand injection with the module sheafification unit is injective. If two such sections have the same image, Mathlib Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem for the underlying abelian sheafification unit gives a covering equalizer sieve on V. Transport this sieve to Over.mk phi using Sieve.overEquiv. Restriction of both elements lies in the same summand indexed by b >> phi, so DirectSum.of_injective gives equality of the restricted slice sections. Separatedness of G gives equality of the original sections, also for empty covering sieves. No separatedness assertion about the whole extension presheaf is needed.

Prove faithfulness of the sheafified extension: equality of extended maps, combined with naturality of the module sheafification adjunction unit, gives equality after applying that unit to both presheaf maps. Evaluate at the phi-summand injection and use DirectSum.lmap_of, then the preceding injectivity result, to recover equality on every section of each slice object. Sectionwise extensionality gives equality of the input morphisms.

The extension presheaf preserves zero morphisms: check its direct-sum linear map on zero, each summand and sums. Module sheafification preserves zero morphisms as an additive-category left adjoint. Rewrite the assumed image-kernel equality as exactness of S.map L using Mathlib ShortComplex.exact_iff_image_eq_kernel. Apply Mathlib Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful. This reflection theorem does not require preservation of exactness, kernels, cokernels or homology by L.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedSliceExtension_reflects_exact
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (S : ShortComplex (ringedSiteModules.{max u v} (((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj O).over U)))
    (hS : let R := (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj O
      let L := extensionByZeroPresheaf.{max u v} R U ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{max u v} (𝟙 R.obj)
      imageSubobject (L.map S.f) = kernelSubobject (L.map S.g)) :
    S.Exact
